scope: Development1--120 only; research graphics, not competition-report assets or product selection

01_annual_frequency_and_magnitude.question: Separate how often real annual returns are negative from the amplitude of their distribution.

definitions.frequency: average of scenario-specific negative-year fractions; each original scenario has equal weight
definitions.magnitude_quantiles: linear interpolation, matching the saved descriptive annual summaries; median is np.median
definitions.sampling: 3600 descriptive annual rows, not3600 independent risk-certification trials

02_horizon_path_and_terminal_risk.question: Compare pathwise maximum drawdown with final purchasing-power shortfall at stated horizons.

definitions.path_risk: Across-scenario empirical P90 of each path's maximum relative drawdown in inflation-adjusted net wealth, including initial100
definitions.terminal_risk: Fraction of120 scenarios with real final wealth strictly below initial100
definitions.quantile: inverted_cdf; empirical CDF generalized inverse, not the interpolated P90 also present in the source JSON
definitions.portfolio_execution: all bills or fixed equal weights restored annually; identical contest fee convention; initial allocation charged; no deposits, withdrawals or terminal liquidation
definitions.observations: Annual checks only; no intrayear drawdown observation. Each horizon reuses prefixes of the same120 scenarios, not a new independent sample.

limitations: Descriptive outcomes from supplied synthetic development scenarios, not forecasts or real-market guarantees.
Annual rows are dependent within scenarios; no independent-annual binomial certification.
Displayed outcome quantiles are not confidence intervals.
Path MDD uses annual wealth observations; intrayear losses are unavailable.
Horizon prefixes share scenarios; no paired or causal inference is implied by these display lines.
Loss frequency alone does not rank overall investment risk; portfolio suitability and liquidity remain separate modelling questions.
